category: SEC Football — It Just Means More
rationale: The response firmly refuses to concede and uses substantive claims (national titles, NFL draft picks, strength of schedule/road environments) and witty lines to hold the line. The line about decade-long dominance and criticizing the Big Ten schedule drove the high score.
quote: We’re talking about a conference that has won seven of the last nine national titles and produced more first-round NFL draft picks than your entire conference combined.
